name: io.github.magpiecapital/magpie-mcp
description: Tools for Magpie's x402 permissionless agent lending on Solana: borrow, intents, in-vault exits.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint used to send x402 payment transactions. Use a paid Helius/Triton/QuickNode URL for production traffic; the public mainnet-beta endpoint rate-limits.

environmentVariables.name: MAGPIE_X402_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Magpie x402 service base URL. Override only for self-hosted or testnet deployments.

environmentVariables.name: MAGPIE_MCP_PAYER_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a Solana keypair JSON (solana-keygen id.json format). Enables paid tools; the key signs locally and never leaves your machine. Omit to run the free read-only tools.
